views.public.combined_animations:
SELECT c.mood,
    c.animations,
    c.npc
   FROM animations_custom c
UNION ALL
 SELECT t.mood,
    t.animations,
    t.npc
   FROM (animations t
     LEFT JOIN animations_custom c ON (((t.mood)::text = (c.mood)::text)))
  WHERE (c.mood IS NULL);

views.public.combined_core_action:
SELECT c.id,
    c.code_name,
    c.action_name,
    c.description,
    c.return_message,
    c.available_to_npc,
    c.available_to_followers,
    c.available_to_narrator,
    c.is_activated,
    c.parameters_json,
    c.metadata,
    c.game_function,
    c.import_version,
    c.script_proxy_program,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at
   FROM core_action_custom c
UNION ALL
 SELECT b.id,
    b.code_name,
    b.action_name,
    b.description,
    b.return_message,
    b.available_to_npc,
    b.available_to_followers,
    b.available_to_narrator,
    b.is_activated,
    b.parameters_json,
    b.metadata,
    b.game_function,
    b.import_version,
    b.script_proxy_program,
    b.created_at,
    b.updated_at
   FROM (core_action b
     LEFT JOIN core_action_custom c ON ((lower((b.code_name)::text) = lower((c.code_name)::text))))
  WHERE (c.code_name IS NULL);
views.public.combined_descriptions:
SELECT c.plugin,
    c.baseid,
    c.name,
    c.description
   FROM descriptions_custom c
UNION ALL
 SELECT i.plugin,
    i.baseid,
    i.name,
    i.description
   FROM (descriptions i
     LEFT JOIN descriptions_custom c ON (((i.plugin = c.plugin) AND ((i.baseid)::text = (c.baseid)::text))))
  WHERE (c.baseid IS NULL);

views.public.eventlog_view:
SELECT e.type,
    e.data,
    e.sess,
    e.gamets,
    e.localts,
    e.ts,
    e.rowid,
    e.people,
    e.location,
    e.party,
    convert_gamets2skyrim_date(e.gamets) AS sk_date,
    convert_gamets2skyrim_long_date(e.gamets) AS sk_long_date,
    convert_gamets2days(e.gamets) AS sk_days,
    convert_gamets2gregorian_date(e.gamets) AS gregorian_date
   FROM eventlog e;
views.public.locations_v:
SELECT locations.name,
    locations.formid,
    locations.region,
    locations.hold,
    locations.tags,
    locations.factions,
    locations.is_interior,
    locations.vanilla_location,
    locations.coords,
    locations.refs,
    locations.cleared,
    locations.updated_at,
    locations.world,
    locations.chim_added
   FROM locations
  WHERE
        CASE
            WHEN ((locations.formid = 102771) AND (locations.cleared = false)) THEN false
            ELSE true
        END;
views.public.memory_v:
SELECT subquery.message,
    subquery.uid,
    subquery.gamets,
    subquery.speaker,
    subquery.listener,
    subquery.ts
   FROM ( SELECT memory.message,
            memory.uid,
            memory.gamets,
            '-'::text AS speaker,
            '-'::text AS listener,
            memory.ts
           FROM memory
          WHERE ((memory.message !~~ 'Dear Diary%'::text) AND (memory.message <> ''::text) AND ((memory.event)::text <> 'backgroundlife_diary'::text))
        UNION
         SELECT ((((('(Context Location:'::text || speech.location) || ') '::text) || speech.speaker) || ': '::text) || speech.speech),
            (speech.rowid)::integer AS rowid,
            speech.gamets,
            speech.speaker,
            speech.listener,
            speech.ts
           FROM speech
          WHERE (speech.speech <> ''::text)
        UNION
         SELECT eventlog.data,
            (eventlog.rowid)::integer AS rowid,
            eventlog.gamets,
            '-'::text AS text,
            '-'::text AS listener,
            eventlog.ts
           FROM eventlog
          WHERE ((eventlog.type)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('death'::character varying)::text, ('location'::character varying)::text]))) subquery
  ORDER BY subquery.gamets, subquery.ts;
views.public.speech_view:
SELECT s.sess,
    s.speaker,
    s.speech,
    s.location,
    s.listener,
    s.topic,
    s.localts,
    s.gamets,
    s.ts,
    s.rowid,
    s.companions,
    s.audios,
    convert_gamets2skyrim_date(s.gamets) AS sk_date,
    convert_gamets2skyrim_long_date(s.gamets) AS sk_long_date,
    convert_gamets2days(s.gamets) AS sk_days,
    convert_gamets2gregorian_date(s.gamets) AS gregorian_date
   FROM speech s;
